system.description:
Range 10ft; one corpse; cast at night only.

  • Raises one undead, its type set by your caster level: 15–16 a mummy, 17–18 a spectre, 19–20 a vampire, 21+ a ghost.
  • It uses that creature's stat block in Monsters & Treasure.
  • It obeys you permanently and counts towards your Undead Mastery cap.
  • Material: a black onyx worth 100 gp per HD, consumed.

Costed component (‡): black onyx, as Create Undead.

Classes: Necromancer (class-only spell, from the class entry)
